key_points.text: My guest today is Casey Hamann, founder of AQIS LLC.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest today is Casey Hamann, founder of AQIS LLC.

key_points.text: Casey is a Lauren Buffett disciple and spent his first decade in the industry working as an analyst at discretionary deep value long short hedge funds.

thesis: The guest argues that his quantitative approach aims to systematize discretionary stock-picking skills while removing the behavioral biases he observed during his decade working as an analyst in discretionary long-short equity funds. He explains that his background involves a value-oriented mindset focused on time arbitrage, where investors estimate a range of intrinsic value rather than specific price targets to identify healthy margins of safety.
